# Devspace Final Schema Pipeline (draft v0.1)

Turns each path's **Glossary Learning Bundles** into **tile lessons** — the screens, visuals, questions, answer keys, datasets and code exercises the player renders — authored once, validated by scripts, stored. **Role-agnostic**: one pipeline for all 64 paths. Spec: `00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/PLAYBOOK.md`.

## Status (2026-11-06)
**Data Analyst is finished:** 72 tiles (12 regions, 168 concepts, 783 steps, 383 interactions, 223 remediation steps) generated by the Bedrock driver in `batches/final_batch_002…013`, every stage gated PASS in each batch ledger including the independent final audit (`11_final_audit`). Spend $965.74 (about $5.75 per concept; the playbook targeted $0.65, and the first path also paid for building the runtimes, checkers and driver).
Built and tested: schemas (16 block types, 12 interaction types, registries), the stage scripts (`preflight` · `plan_tiles` · `assemble_tiles` · `validate_tile` · `update_ledger` · `build_unions` · `visual_inventory` · `selftest`), pack checkers, per-path profiles, stage instruction files and agents; the unattended driver `run_pipeline.py` (+ `deploy/` supervisor and ops scripts) with the integrity guard, budget caps and an offline `test_driver.py`; four verified code runtimes in `sandbox/` (`sql`, `python`, `spreadsheet`, `chart_renderer`, see `registry/runtimes.json`); the evaluator-packet renderer (`evaluator_packet.py`): stages 03/04 are judged from one tool-free call, falling back to the agent evaluator (`--eval-mode agent` forces the old way); `grader-core/`, the shared TypeScript grader for every interaction type (replays every finished tile's answer key: 1,292 tests pass).
Backend handoff: `docs/handoff/BACKEND_HANDOFF.md` (+ appendices A, B, C, E) and `BACKEND_DECISIONS.md`.
**Not done:** stage 12 (publish, waits on the backend contract); the backend itself and the player's integration of `grader-core`; the other 63 paths (Data Analyst is the only one built; the pipeline is role-agnostic, a new path starts from `01_FINAL_PACK_TEMPLATE/NEW_ROLE_RUNBOOK.md`); cost per concept is far above target; the known grader gaps are listed in `grader-core/README.md`.

## Layout
```
00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/  PLAYBOOK.md  pipeline_manifest.json
  schemas/   one JSON Schema per block (block.*), interaction (ix.*), plus tile_lesson, step, registry, plan, parts, ledger
  registry/  block_registry · interaction_registry · anchor_mapping · path_profiles/<path_id>.json
  scripts/   the stages + finlib · schema_check · selftest · checkers/{core,data,dataset}.py
01_FINAL_PACK_TEMPLATE/  START_HERE.md  NEW_ROLE_RUNBOOK.md  <stage>/{GENERATOR,EVALUATOR,RUN}.md
.claude/agents/  final-generator (Sonnet) · final-evaluator (Opus)
examples/        demo_parity_interactions.json   batches/<batch_id>/  every artifact of one batch
```

## Try it (needs `pip install jsonschema`)
```bash
B=batches/final_batch_001_da_canary; S=00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/scripts
python3 $S/validate_tile.py $B --registry && python3 $S/assemble_tiles.py $B && python3 $S/validate_tile.py $B --strict
python3 $S/selftest.py $B
python3 $S/run_pipeline.py batches/<new_batch> --max-usd 25 --plan      # what a driver run would do, no spend (drop --plan to run on Bedrock)
python3 $S/visual_inventory.py <path_glossary_bundle.data_analyst.json>      # what a path needs from the player
```

## Decisions (2026-10-20, with the user)
Pre-authored content now, runtime-generated "custom path" later · scenario/asset registry before any screens, glossary examples may be re-voiced to registry values (facts unchanged, evaluator-checked) · client-graded checks, server-graded assessments · core visual set + pluggable per-domain packs (datasets/spreadsheets are one pack, not the model) · player prototype is the localhost:5180 app · canary first, then Bedrock on EC2 like the glossary pack · Thesys/OpenUI not adopted for core content.
